name: Project Midnight Sun
description: An orbital mirror array that can turn noon to midnight over any capital on Earth — or focus dawn into a lance of fire. Steal its heart, raise it into orbit, and dictate terms to a darkened world. The core can be taken by force, extorted, or bought; the world's answer can be silenced, seduced, or bankrupted. Choose your path.
victoryNarrative: At 11:58 local time, the sky over the World Assembly dims. Not a cloud, not an eclipse — a shadow with edges, cast by ten thousand mirrors turning in perfect silence four hundred kilometers up. By 12:01 the markets have noticed. By 12:04, the generals. By 12:07, everyone else.

Your broadcast is forty seconds long. You do not shout. You do not demand. You simply list the cities, the hours of daylight remaining to each, and an account number. The interceptors never launch; the ministries never object; the money is already moving. It turns out the world was for sale after all — it just needed someone to name the price.

In the caldera of Mount Cinder, the Obsidian Throne is warm from the afternoon light you have graciously permitted. Somewhere below, a henchman is already painting your next scheme on the war room wall. The Midnight Sun hangs overhead, patient as winter. Let them have their little daylight. It's yours now, on loan.
